arrangement.notes: Arrangement optimized for club energy with aggressive mood in West Coast Hip-Hop style, instrumental only.

event_markers.reason: Increase energy and groove with drum pattern changes

event_markers.reason: Bass line intensifies to build club energy

track_roles.drums: Drive rhythm and accentuate aggressive, energetic beats.
track_roles.bass: Provide deep, punchy low-end with groove fitting West Coast style.
track_roles.chords: Support harmonic texture with sparse, rhythmic stabs.
track_roles.melody: No melodic content - instrumental variation without lead melodies.
track_roles.fx: Enhance transitions and build energy with sound effects.

sensei_drum.brief: Create aggressive, punchy drum patterns with tight kick and snare hits that drive club energy for a West Coast Hip-Hop instrumental.

bass_generator.brief: Generate a deep, rhythmic bass line that complements drums and adds groove while maintaining aggressive energy.

harmony_generator.brief: Produce sparse chord stabs that provide harmonic support without overwhelming the instrumental focus.

melody_generator.brief: Do not generate melodic content as the variation is instrumental and melody is omitted.

ai_designer.brief: Design the arrangement structure with defined sections that build and release energy appropriate for an aggressive club mood.

presetor.brief: Apply presets that accentuate punch and clarity in drums and bass, with appropriate effects for transitions and tension.

songgps.brief: Guide the arrangement's energy curve and section transitions to maintain dynamic interest and aggressive mood throughout.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare mix guidelines that keep drum and bass prominence and clarity, ensuring energy and aggression are clearly conveyed.
